survivors.role_need: WordPress Developer — Elementor, performant and optimized WordPress solutions
survivors.evidence: Official live careers page currently lists a WordPress Developer role and explicitly asks for WordPress site development/management with strong Elementor competence; the same official page also exposes jobs@mszlab.it for spontaneous applications.

survivors.role_need: Freelance agency collaboration — digital/web production overflow
survivors.evidence: Official agency careers page explicitly separates an option for freelancers who want to collaborate with the agency from employee and company routes, providing a current collaboration surface for external talent.

survivors.role_need: WordPress Web Designer — maintenance, troubleshooting and technical management of WordPress sites
survivors.evidence: Official careers page currently lists a WordPress Web Designer role in the Web Genius department, including WordPress maintenance, backend management, theme/plugin updates, troubleshooting and site-operation checks.

metrics.note: READY pressure remained below 5, so discovery emphasized explicit current demand and direct authoritative collaboration/careers surfaces. Known identities including Ibérica Studio, Broovera, Ualà Online, Redman, iDEA, Nokeon and Mobyleshop were rejected early as duplicates/previously processed signals. EU-language-compatible probes produced no new survivor above threshold in this run; stale Freelancer marketplace listings were rejected cheaply.
